fact: The report states the legal base of the national statistical system is law 2004-21 of 21 July 2004 as amended by law 2012-03 of 3 January 2012, with decrees of 23 May 2005 on the CNS and ANSD, and that a further revision of the law is planned.
title: Troisième Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique (SNDS III 2019-2023), Rapport final
publisher: Conseil national de la statistique / ANSD
